app.drawer.noController: No controller input for this action

app.error.BadImage: That file is not an image Obsidian can use: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 4 MB.
app.error.GameFilesChanged: The game files don't match a known build, so the changes in this mod can't be worked out. If a mod was copied into the game folder by hand, verify the game files in Steam and import it again.
app.error.GameNotFound: The game was not found. Choose the game folder in Settings.
app.error.Busy: Another deploy or purge is running. Try again when it ends.

app.error.LastProfile: The last profile cannot be deleted.
app.error.NoRelease: That repository has no release with a version number.

app.error.NoUpdateSource: This mod names no GitHub repository to update from.
app.error.ProfileExists: A profile with that name already exists.
app.error.ProfileName: Use 1 to 40 characters, without \ / : * ? " < > |, and without a space or dot at either end.
app.error.PurgeStuck: Purge couldn't remove a file, so run it again with the game closed: %s
app.error.UpdateLimited: GitHub's limit on update checks was reached. Try again in about an hour.
app.error.UpdateMismatch: The latest release is not a newer version of this mod, so Obsidian left the mod as it was.
app.error.UpdateNetwork: GitHub could not be reached, or it is limiting requests. Try again later.

app.folder.name: Name

app.folder.ungroupHint: Back to the main list, outside any folder.
app.folder.updatesHint: Open the folder to update them.

app.guardrails.lead: For the current profile. Changes apply the next time the game launches.

app.image.chooseHint: A square image works best: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 4 MB.
app.modUpdates.none: Every mod is up to date.
app.mods.addHint: Import mods from a .zip file or a folder, or drop them on the list.
app.mods.checkUpdatesNone: None of the checked mods names a GitHub repository to check.

app.mods.resizeHint: Drag to resize. Double-click to reset.
app.mods.updateAllHint: Download and install every new version found. Deploy afterwards to use them.
app.mods.updateHint: Download and install this version. Deploy afterwards to use it.
app.mods.updateText: This installs version %s over version %s. Deploy afterwards to use it.
app.problem.broken: These mods can't be read and are left out of the game: %s
app.problem.damaged: The profile %s was damaged, so it started over. The old file is in the profiles folder.
app.profiles.colorHint: Tints the Profile button and the switches that are on while this profile is in use.
app.profiles.deleteText: Delete this profile, with the load order, options and keys in it. The mods stay in the library.
app.profiles.duplicateHint: Makes a new profile with the same mods, order, options and keys.
app.profiles.exportHint: Save this profile as a ZIP to share: load order, folders, options, keys and the files of every mod that is on.
app.profiles.guardedOff: No guardrails on the account in this profile
app.profiles.guardedOn: Guardrails protect the account in this profile
app.profiles.importHint: Add a profile from a ZIP exported by Obsidian, with the mods inside.
app.profiles.imported: Added the profile %s and installed %s mods
app.profiles.importedGuardrails: %s comes with guardrails on: %s. Change them in Guardrails.
app.profiles.importedOne: Added the profile %s and installed 1 mod
app.profiles.lead: A profile keeps the load order, which mods are on, option values, keys and the Guardrails. Switching profile asks for a Deploy when the mods in the game differ.
app.profiles.name: Name
app.profiles.title: Profiles
app.scope.clientHint: Changes only the local game. Safe to play with anyone.
app.scope.expansionHint: Adds new content, such as a game mode, and leaves the rest of the game unchanged. Outside that content it works like a client mod. The content starts only when every player in the lobby runs it.
app.scope.hybridHint: Uses Hybrid Scopes. What this mod does only for the local game runs in any lobby. What it changes for the whole lobby runs only when every player can run it too.
app.scope.libraryHint: Code other mods build on. It counts as a session mod when a session mod needs it, and as a client mod otherwise.
app.scope.sessionHint: Changes the game for the whole lobby, so it runs only when every player can run it too.
app.scope.unspecifiedHint: The author didn't say whether this mod changes only the local game or the whole lobby. Runs as a client mod in any lobby, so other players may notice the changes.
app.settings.animationsSystem: Off because Windows reduces motion. Switch them on here to override.
app.settings.backupsHint: Saves are copied before every deploy, and the latest copies are kept.
app.settings.build.notFound: Choose the folder that holds the game contents folder.
app.settings.build.unknown: Some game files differ from the known build. Deploy and Play still work.
app.settings.dataHint: The library, profiles and save backups.
app.settings.noBackups: No backups yet. The first one is made at the first deploy.
app.settings.portable: Portable copy: the data folder sits beside the app.
app.settings.portableHint: Portable copy: download new versions from the releases page.
app.settings.reportHint: Copies the versions, the mods that are on and the end of the game log for a bug report. The Windows account name is left out.
app.settings.starterDone: The Obsidian Kit is back. Deploy to apply it.
app.settings.starterHint: Restores any that were deleted and the Obsidian Kit folder, and resets those mods to default settings in the active profile.
app.settings.starterLabel: Obsidian API, Obsidian Trainer and Obsidian Patches
app.settings.starterText: In the profile %s, the three mods go back to the top of the list, in the Obsidian Kit folder, with default options and keys. Only Obsidian Patches stays on, plus anything other mods need. An updated mod keeps the newer version. Other mods stay as they are.
app.settings.updateMode: When a new version is out
app.settings.updates.autoHint: At startup, Obsidian installs a new version and restarts.
app.settings.updates.manualHint: Checks at startup and shows the new version here.
app.settings.updates.promptHint: At startup, Obsidian asks before installing a new version.
app.settings.useSteamHint: Find the game through the Steam libraries again

progress_frozen: Progression is frozen for this launch: nothing earned or spent is saved.

app.drawer.partOffHint: The option that switches this secondary scope on is off, so it doesn't run.
app.guardrails.blockPublic: Block session mods from other players in public lobbies
app.guardrails.blockPublicHint: Off: session mods from other players run and can change the game, such as enemies, damage and missions. On: they switch off in public lobbies. Friends-only and private lobbies are never blocked.
app.guardrails.stateBlockPublicOff: Session mods from other players: allowed
app.guardrails.stateBlockPublicOn: Session mods from other players: blocked in public lobbies
app.profiles.blockPublicOff: Allows session mods from other players

app.settings.animationsHint: Fades, slides and the glow that crosses the bar.
app.settings.gameTip: Where HELLDIVERS is installed, and whether Obsidian knows this build.
app.settings.otherHint: Patches placed in the game folder by another tool or by hand. The game loads them with the mods, Obsidian patches go above them, and Purge leaves them alone.
app.settings.otherNone: None. Every patch in the game folder comes from Obsidian.
app.settings.otherRemoveHint: Moves them out of the game folder, into the Obsidian data folder
app.settings.otherRemoveText: The %s patches move to the removed-patches folder in the Obsidian data folder, and can be copied back by hand. Anything another tool installed with them stops working.
app.settings.otherRemoved: Removed %s other patches. Copies are in the data folder.
app.settings.otherRemovedOne: Removed 1 other patch. A copy is in the data folder.
app.settings.scaleHint: Everything in the window: text, icons and spacing.
app.game.unknownHint: Some game files differ from the build Obsidian knows. Deploy and Play still work. Click for details.
app.build.title: Game files changed
app.build.lead: These files don't match the Steam release of HELLDIVERS that Obsidian was made for (build 6001293). Deploy and Play still work, and Obsidian never writes over these files.
app.build.meansBundles: A mod was copied straight into the contents folder of the game, over the original files. Mods from Obsidian load on top of it and win where both change the same thing, so the copied mod may break or the game may act oddly.
app.build.meansExe: The game program is a different version or was patched. The loader checks the version when the game starts. On a mismatch no mod runs and the game says so.
app.build.fixTitle: To get the known files back
app.build.fix2: In Steam, right-click HELLDIVERS, open Properties > Installed Files and choose Verify integrity of game files.
app.build.fix3: Add the copied mods again with Add mods, so Obsidian deploys them without touching the game files.
app.build.note: Adding mods compares them with the original files, so it waits until the files match again.

app.saves.deployLoaderOfficial: The active save is Official and needs no loader.
app.saves.duplicateHint: A new Sandbox with the same progress.

app.saves.editHint: Rank, samples, unlocks, cosmetics, campaign and mod data.

app.saves.isLive: These are the game files right now, with a Sandbox selected over them.
app.saves.leaveText: Leaving now loses the unsaved changes to this save.
app.saves.maxHint: Top rank, samples at the cap, every item unlocked and every upgrade, owned DLC included.
app.saves.maxText: Sets the top rank, samples at the cap, every item unlocked and every upgrade at the top. Paid DLC not owned on Steam stays out. This is written to the save right away.
app.saves.modDisabledHint: This mod is off in the active profile. Turn the mod on to change these values. The data stays in the save.
app.saves.modRemovedHint: This data belongs to a mod that is no longer in the library.
app.saves.name: Name
app.saves.needsDeploy: The active save is a Sandbox and the Obsidian loader is not in the game. Without a deploy, the game opens the Official save in the game files.
app.saves.newHint: A blank Sandbox or Official save, or a Sandbox imported from a zip file.
app.saves.noModData: No mod in the library adds anything to this save.

app.saves.ownFirst: Turn this item on to change the upgrades.
app.saves.ownedOnSteamHint: Steam grants this DLC to the account, so the item is always owned. The upgrades can be changed.
app.saves.paidDlcHint: Not owned on this Steam account, going by the Official saves. Obsidian never writes paid DLC the account does not own.

app.saves.resetHint: Rank 1 with no samples, unlocks or upgrades. Lifetime stats and cosmetics stay.

app.saves.restoreHint: Writes this snapshot over the game files. The save in use stays in the library.
app.saves.samplesHint: %s samples make 1 research point. The cap is %s samples.
app.saves.sandboxHint: Saves on this PC only, kept apart from the Official files and free to edit. Sandbox players only match with each other.

app.saves.saveOrDiscardFirst: Save or discard the waiting changes first.

app.saves.switchHint: The game boots this save next.

app.saves.unknownHint: The save lists these, but the catalog does not know them. They stay in the save.

app.commander.lead: Host custom Galactic Wars for HELLDIVERS: run the fronts, start defenses and push the enemy, then fight the war in the game.
app.commander.installNote: Downloads the newest Commander release from GitHub: the war server and the war screens, updated apart from Obsidian.
app.commander.cardHostText: The war server runs on this PC, with no account and no outside service. Each war has separate fronts, events and rules, and can be paused, edited, exported or shared as a file.
app.commander.cardFriendsText: Open a war to LAN and players on the same network find it with Join War. Open it to the internet and friends elsewhere join with the invite code. Each player fights the same war in the game.
app.commander.cardSafeText: A custom war plays on a Sandbox save and in a separate matchmaking pool. Nothing from it reaches the official Galactic War or the Official save, and the official war stays one choice away in Play.
app.commander.uninstalled: Commander package removed. Wars and war saves stay on this PC.
app.commander.firewallTitle: Allow LAN Wars Through the Firewall
app.commander.firewallText: The firewall on this PC (%s) keeps other players from joining wars hosted here, and hides wars on the network from Join War. Obsidian can open the ports Commander uses: TCP 17494 to 17499 and UDP 17493. The system asks for the password. Remove All Commander Data closes them again.
app.commander.firewallOpened: LAN ports opened in the firewall
app.commander.firewallDeclined: The firewall stays as it was
app.commander.firewallFailed: The LAN ports could not be opened: %s
app.commander.firewallJoinHint: The firewall on this PC can hide wars on the network.
app.commander.firewallKeptLinux: The LAN ports stay open in the firewall: the system did not give permission to close them.
app.commander.wipeFirewallHintLinux: The LAN ports Obsidian opened in the firewall. The system asks for the password to close them.
app.commander.nothing: No war screens to show. Install the package or join a LAN war.
app.commander.selected: %s selected: the next launch plays this war
app.commander.clientInstalling: Getting the Enhanced War Client mod
app.commander.clientInstalled: Enhanced War Client %s installed and enabled in the active profile
app.commander.clientEnabled: Enhanced War Client enabled in the active profile
app.commander.clientFailed: The Enhanced War Client mod could not be installed: %s
app.commander.officialSelected: The next launch plays the official war
app.commander.gameRunning: Close the game before switching wars
app.commander.joinLead: Wars open to LAN on this network, and wars at an address typed below, with the invite code of the host. A war joined here plays on a Sandbox save.
app.commander.scanning: Listening for wars on the network
app.commander.noneFound: No war found. The host opens a war to LAN from the war screen, and both PCs need to be on the same network.
app.commander.addressNone: No war answered at that address. A war joined from another network needs the invite code of the host.
app.commander.inviteHint: The code the host shares with the address, for a war on another network. A war on this network needs none.

app.error.CommanderPackage: Not a Commander package, or one for another version of Obsidian

app.error.CommanderRunning: A Commander war server is still running, such as one started with obsidian commander serve. Stop it and try again.
app.commander.importWarHint: Adds a war from a war file (.json)
app.commander.newWarHint: Creates a war hosted on this PC
app.commander.noRelease: No Commander release to download yet. A local build installs with Install from File.

app.commander.joinHint: Find wars opened to LAN on this network. Joining needs no package.
app.commander.uninstallText: Remove the Commander package? The war server and the war screens leave this PC. Wars and war saves stay: Remove All Commander Data in this menu takes those too.
app.commander.wipeText: Everything Commander keeps on this PC goes, and the next launch plays the official war. This can't be undone: export a war from the war screen first to keep it.
app.commander.wipeFirewallHint: Windows Firewall rules made when a war was opened to LAN. Windows asks for permission to remove them.
app.commander.wipedKept: Commander data removed. %s war saves stay in Saves: they couldn't be deleted.
app.commander.firewallKept: Windows Firewall rules stay: Windows didn't give permission to remove them.
